part.name: Integral clevis mounting bracket
part.description: A single-solid structural bracket with four mounting lugs and through holes, an elevated two-ear clevis with a coaxial pin passage, and a network of load-carrying webs surrounding an underside relief cavity. The part appears intended to connect a pinned linkage to a four-point mounted structure.
part.symmetry_note: The clevis ears and pin bores form an exact coaxial pair along the CAD X direction. The four mounting-hole stations form two end pairs but are not a simple globally circular pattern. The structural web layout is approximately bilateral about the clevis center region, with visible geometric asymmetry at the two longitudinal ends.

semantic_orientation.description: The broad four-hole flange is interpreted as the mounting underside, and the projecting clevis is interpreted as the upper or outward side. CAD +Y therefore most likely points upward/outward and CAD -Y toward the mounting side. No reliable human-semantic front/back or left/right assignment can be inferred for the remaining CAD directions.

unclassified_brep_faces.description: Inclusive FACE ranges assigned to the integral structural body and its transition network. They comprise secondary outer walls, internal support surfaces, local fillets, small spherical and toroidal corner patches, and B-spline transition faces not confidently separable into additional engineering features. Important mounting, web, cavity, and clevis faces are excluded from these ranges.
